title: Toddler Easter Egg Hunt, Garden Basket Romper - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid outdoor snapshot of a barefoot toddler bent over exploring the soil and plants in a garden bed right beside the sunlit clapboard wall of a home. Beside the child sits a small woven Easter basket containing treats or eggs. The toddler wears a light-colored summer sunsuit or rompers. Behind them, large multi-pane windows reflect leafy foliage under sunny skies. The reverse of the photograph displays heavy black ink or album mounting paper residue along the corners.
